about: Origin of Power: one d100 roll. The table calls the sixth origin Technical Procedure and the text below it Technical Experiment; they are the same entry.

origins.name: Natal
origins.summary: Born with the body and the Powers.

origins.name: Maturity
origins.summary: Powers arrived in adulthood, perhaps after flickers in youth.

origins.name: Self-Achievement
origins.summary: The hero sought Power and found a way: science, study or training.

origins.name: Endowment
origins.summary: Another being, or an object, gave the hero Power.

origins.name: Technical Mishap
origins.summary: An experiment or procedure went wrong and cannot be exactly repeated.

origins.name: Technical Procedure
origins.summary: A deliberate procedure that could be repeated, if anyone had kept notes.

origins.name: Creation
origins.summary: Made as an adult with Powers: robots, androids, angels and the like.

origins.name: Biological Exposure
origins.summary: A creature or something it secreted, like a werewolf's bite.

origins.name: Chemical Exposure
origins.summary: An exotic substance, breathed, eaten, injected or touched.

origins.name: Energy Exposure
origins.summary: An unusual form or intensity of energy.

origins.name: Rebirth
origins.summary: The hero died and came back in a new body with Power.
